quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (10-31-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 194,537 million (+8.7% YoY), operating income JPY 78,871 million (+3.8%, 40.5% margin), ordinary income JPY 79,465 million (+5.9%), net income attributable to owners JPY 55,913 million (+4.6%). Management states demand stayed high, centered on generative AI, while semiconductors for smartphones and PCs showed no full recovery; precision processing equipment shipments were firm, centered on high-value-added products, and consumable precision processing tool shipments stayed high in line with customers' equipment utilization, giving record half-year shipments. Gross margin fell on currency effects and SG&A rose, mainly R&D (group R&D spending JPY 15,661 million in the half).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 FY2026 sales JPY 194,537 million +8.7%; OP margin 40.5%
